notes.title: Devlog #3 – Chapter 3 Progress
notes.content:
[p]Hello!
This is [b]Happy Slugs[/b], the development team behind [i]Kill The Clock[/i].[/p][p]We know many of you have been waiting, so here’s our development update for this month.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Chapter 3 Progress[/h3][p][b]Scenario / Script Work[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Overall story flow and main plot structure ([b]Completed[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Scene-by-scene developments, dialogue flow, and branching structure ([b]Completed[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]Actual script writing and direction notes ([b]65%[/b]) 🆕[/p][/*][*][p]In-game script implementation ([b]0%[/b])[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Art Resources[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Investigation items & background images ([b]70%[/b]) 🆕[/p][/*][*][p]Event CGs ([b]50%[/b]) 🆕[/p][/*][*][p]Ending CGs ([b]80%[/b]) 🆕[/p][/*][/olist][p]This month, we finished writing the scripts for Days 1–3 and are currently working on Day 4.
For art resources, investigation items and backgrounds for Days 1–3 have been completed, and we are now producing assets for Days 4–5.
Event CGs are at 50%, and Ending CGs are at 80%.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Plans for September[/h3][list][*][p]Bug fixes and stability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Completion of Chapter 3 script writing[/p][/*][*][p]Completion of Chapter 3 investigation items, backgrounds, and CGs[/p][/*][*][p]Begin implementing Chapter 3 scripts into the game[/p][/*][/list][p]As we mentioned in our previous devlog, we had planned additional features such as controller support.
Unfortunately, we couldn’t proceed with those this month since our top priority is completing Chapter 3’s script.
We sincerely apologize to those who were waiting for feature updates.[/p][p]Because one person is handling both programming and script work, it’s difficult to develop new features during months focused on script writing.
Our goal for September is to [b]100% complete Chapter 3’s scripts and art resources[/b], after which we will gradually move on to feature updates.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][p]Thanks to your encouragement, we’ve been able to continue development steadily.
We truly appreciate your patience and warm support.[/p][p]We’ll see you again in the next devlog. Until then, please take care and have a wonderful time![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you!
— Happy Slugs 🐌[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2 – July Update & Chapter 3 Progress
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,
We’re [b]Happy Slugs[/b], the team behind [i]Kill The Clock[/i].[/p][p]First of all, we want to sincerely apologize for not being able to finish some of the new features we had planned for this month.
As a two-person team, both of us were heavily involved in preparing for and attending [b]BitSummit[/b], an indie game festival held in Japan—and as a result, development was more disrupted than we expected.[/p][p]That said, while we couldn’t complete new feature development, we’ve been actively fixing bugs as reports come in.
Also, [b]progress on the Chapter 3 script is going smoothly[/b], so we hope you're looking forward to it![/p][p]Here’s a breakdown of what we’ve been working on this month:[/p][hr][/hr][h2]July Key Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted mouse offset[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu layout bugs in specific resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input issues in certain languages[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected translation errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor animation/object bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the dialogue choice display when viewing the log[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where saving wasn’t possible on some chapter ending screens[/p][/*][*][p]Added a required interaction with a specific character in a specific scene
→ ([i]This led to a new bug where the story could become blocked on Chapter 1, Day 3 if visited in a certain order — we released a [b]hotfix in v0.5.15[/b] to resolve this.[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes and polish[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Chapter 3 Progress[/h2][h3]● Scenario & Script[/h3][olist][*][p]Overall story flow and major plot planning – 🟢 Completed[/p][/*][*][p]Scene-by-scene structure, dialogue flow, and branching logic – 🟢 Completed [b](New!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Writing full dialogue – 🟡 [b]10% complete[/b] [b](New!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Implementing the script in-game – ⚪ Not started[/p][/*][/olist][h3]● Art Assets[/h3][olist][*][p]Investigation items and background art – 🟡 [b]35% complete[/b] [b](New!)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Event CGs – ⚪ Not started[/p][/*][*][p]Ending CGs – ⚪ Not started[/p][/*][/olist][p]This month, we completed all scene-by-scene story structure and dialogue flow planning.
We’re now working on writing the actual dialogue for [b]Day 1[/b].[/p][p]We’ve also begun creating art assets such as investigation items and background illustrations.
As of now, visuals for [b]Day 1 and Day 2[/b] are roughly complete.
Note: Some detailed item graphics may be adjusted later once the final script is ready.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Development Plans for August–September[/h2][list][*][p]Add controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Remove the "gift/bribe limit" from investigation scenes (except for initial character meetings)[/p][/*][*][p]Implement Steam Cloud Save[/p][/*][*][p]Improve how currency is earned[/p][/*][*][p]Continue bug fixes and stability improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Continue Chapter 3 dialogue writing[/p][/*][*][p]Create Chapter 3 investigation items, background art, and event CGs[/p][/*][/list][p]To meet our timeline for Chapter 3, the top priority is completing the dialogue script.
However, since our [b]lead programmer is also in charge of dialogue writing[/b], it may take a bit longer for us to deliver new feature updates.[/p][p]As always, [b]bug fixes come first[/b], so please don’t hesitate to send us reports anytime![/p][hr][/hr][p]We’re so grateful for all your support, which keeps us going even during the summer heat.
Please stay safe and cool—and thank you so much for your continued patience and encouragement.[/p][p]
— Team Happy Slugs 🐌[/p]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Important Update: Game Name Change to 'Kill The Clock'
notes.content:
Dear valued members of our community,

We have an important announcement to share with you regarding a recent change.

Previously known as 'Counter Clock Case,' we've decided to rename our game to 'Kill The Clock.' This change comes after discovering that a well-known podcast titled 'CounterClock' exists, focusing on time travel criminal justice, with the term 'counterclock' being trademarked. Despite our efforts to reach out to the podcast's creators for permission to use a similar name, unfortunately, we haven't received a response.

In order to avoid any potential trademark infringement and future complications, we've made the decision to proactively change the name at this early stage of development.

I'm writing this announcement because I understand that some of you might be surprised by this sudden change. Despite this alteration, our team is working diligently and we're on track to release a demo later this month. 

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. We appreciate your patience as we navigate these changes, and we look forward to sharing more updates with you soon.

Best regards,

Happy Slugs
